text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturady as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
World Bank officials satisfied with the ongoing economic reforms in Algeria.
- Draft law related to general elections to be presented sson to the transitional national council (quasi-parliament).
- The government will take new measures concerning wages in the public sector next summer.
- Teachers return to universities after strike.
- A Canadian government delegation to visit Algiers on Saturday. The delegation will discuss bilateral cooperation with Algerian officials.
- After adoption of darft law by the national council, the Algerian political scene is expected to change.
